property_summary: The fallback only ever completes successfully when exactly 10 ether is sent (any other value must revert); the inverted check makes the buggy contract accept every value except 10 ether, so the rule is broken for e.g. a 0-ether call.
change_summary: Replace the equality check `msg.value == 10 ether` with `msg.value != 10 ether`, inverting which calls succeed.
